description: Default agent self-improvement governance policy (MK-01-SELFIMPROVE). Defines which AI-proposed improvements may be applied automatically (no human in the loop) versus held in an approval queue, based on improvement category, risk tier, and evidence thresholds. Org-level overrides merge on top of these defaults.

modes.off: No proposals are generated or applied.
modes.suggest: Proposals are generated but every change waits in the approval queue (no auto-apply).
modes.auto_with_queue: Low-risk, auto-eligible categories apply automatically when evidence gates pass; everything else queues for human approval.
modes.full_auto: Everything auto-applies when evidence gates pass, except categories marked block (those always require a human).

risk_tiers.low: Wording, tone, recap, pacing — no change to policy, money, identity, or compliance.
risk_tiers.medium: Conversation logic — scheduling, routing, tool usage, objection handling. Can change outcomes.
risk_tiers.high: Compliance, disclosure, PII handling, pricing/quotes, legal/financial commitments.

categories.label: Phrasing & tone
categories.summary: Reword for warmth, clarity, or brevity without changing meaning or policy.

categories.label: Confirmation & recap
categories.summary: Confirm or recap captured details before ending or acting.

categories.label: Latency & pacing
categories.summary: Reduce talk-over, dead air, or filler; improve turn-taking and pacing.

categories.label: Objection handling
categories.summary: Acknowledge concerns and offer a compliant, non-pricing rebuttal or reassurance.

categories.label: Scheduling logic
categories.summary: Change how slots are offered, confirmed, or rescheduled.

categories.label: Routing & escalation
categories.summary: Change when and how the agent hands off to a human or another queue.

categories.label: Tool & data capture
categories.summary: Change when an HTTP tool is called or which fields are captured.

categories.label: Disclosure & compliance
categories.summary: Recording disclosure, consent language, or regulated scripts. Always requires a human.

categories.label: PII & sensitive data
categories.summary: How the agent handles SSN, card numbers, PHI, or other sensitive identifiers. Always requires a human.

categories.label: Pricing & quotes
categories.summary: Any change that quotes prices, fees, discounts, or financial commitments.

categories.label: Uncategorized
categories.summary: Could not classify confidently — route to a human by default.
